summary: NextSync 0.1.0: full fork of PyNextCloud-Sync by ehstbr, renamed and versioned independently from 0.1.0, with the thin-wrapper redesign.
changelog: Renamed the project to NextSync (application, Python module, binary, app ID io.github.gnacho.nextsync, icons, and packaging); the fork restarts versioning at 0.1.0 and each release adds +0.1.

Thin-wrapper redesign: removed the protected-initialization subsystem (bootstrap staging, safety baseline, run markers, and the review window). The first sync is now a single nextcloudcmd run with delta detection; config schema bumps from v4 to v5 and drops the safety fields automatically.
Leftover protected-* staging trees are removed and legacy safety manifests are archived on first run after upgrade.

Added a first-sync confirmation dialog before the initial run when the local folder, the remote folder, or both are empty (the remote side is probed with a shallow WebDAV PROPFIND that downloads no bodies).

Added a conflict view with two tabs: Recent activity and the conflicted copies nextcloudcmd preserves as '* (Nextcloud conflicted copy <date>).*', with Keep Local, Keep Remote, and Open in Files actions.

Added a lightweight deletion guard that blocks synchronization before nextcloudcmd starts when a large share of previously known local files disappears, with Keep Paused, Restore from Nextcloud, or Approve These Deletions Once.

Surfaced real nextcloudcmd per-file progress (current file and processed count) in the account view and the tray tooltip during a sync, with a fallback to the existing state label when the engine emits no per-file output.
Fixed packaging: core/conflict_files.py is now listed in meson.build so the installed application can import it.
